answer_sentences: Originating from the Chinese Ghost Festival, this annual event has evolved into a time of family reunion.
Some people also visit the cemetery to clean up the family graves and pray for their ancestors.
Obon concludes with another bonfire, okuribi, lighting up the sky to see the ancestors’ spirits off.
Such festive activities are usually held in parks, temples, and other public places around Japan.
People with synesthesia used to be accused of making their experiences up.
This consistency serves as a proof that synesthesia is real.
Meanwhile, environmental influences seem to shape a person’s synesthesia.
Some studies even show that people may all be synesthetic to some degree.
This seems to run counter to the common practice.
Many suggest that most patients can continue with the sport they love.
For example, an injured runner might end up cycling and swimming instead of running.
Over time, researchers have come to realize the importance of exercising when injured.
Today, they provide low-budget, overnight lodging in commerce centers in large cities worldwide.
The chambers are stacked side-by-side, two units high, with the upper rooms reached by a ladder.
In response to rising demands, these hotels are embracing a wave of innovation.
The room’s thin plastic walls easily transmit the sound of snoring made by neighboring guests.
For most of recorded human history, the open smile has been deeply unfashionable.
In fact, there is a well-known Russian proverb that goes, “Smiling with no reason is a sign of stupidity.”
Another crucial factor is a society’s immigration diversity.
Various factors have thus contributed to the phenomenon of smiling.
Building an exciting roller coaster starts with a brilliant design.
Designers must then consider the space available for the coaster.
Designers can draw on a number of techniques to provide a memorable ride.
When the design is complete, detailed calculation and careful testing procedures will follow.
topics: how smiling varies across history and cultures

passage_band.basis: SPEC §3.4＋出題規格書 passage_overrides（words、coverage_L1_4_min（取代 SPEC 的區間）、coverage_L1_6_min、offlist_max、beyond_l4_ratio_max）
passage_band.overrides_note: 字數與用字不是難度槓桿（doc §3.2、§3.5）；穩定基礎刻意減輕閱讀負荷，屬產品選擇，方向同 SPEC §3.4

item_rules.summary_zh: 4 格都有明顯的代名詞或轉折詞線索；多餘句主題明顯偏離

preferred_cues: LX（關鍵詞跨句重複或同義）
blank_recipe.direction: BF 為主（兩側都有錨點）；B-only 只配具體指涉
blank_recipe.scope: L（相鄰句可判斷）；P 至多 1 格
blank_recipe.connector_rule: CN 格必須同時有一組詞彙對應（initially→Today、less intelligent→stupidity）；只有連接詞、沒有詞彙對應的格不放在穩定基礎
blank_recipe.competition: 沒有任何其他選項與正解共用同一個先行詞或同一個關鍵詞

answer_level_dist.rule: 正解句用字 L1–5；線索字（被重複的名詞、連接詞）L1–4

distractor_rules.extra_observed_basis: 指考多餘句與每一格前後句都只共用 ≤1 個實詞的 5 篇中，4 篇高分組最高只到 0.03–0.09；例外是 ast-107 的替代論點句（0 個共用詞，卻在段首格吸到高分組 0.44），所以穩定基礎也不放論點型多餘句
distractor_rules.observed_basis: 現制 basic 高分組最強誘答中位數 0.05（IQR [0.028, 0.08]）；指考 basic 0.03

recipe: 先寫一篇段落主題清楚的說明文（3–5 段），每段第一句就是主題句
挑 4 個「兩側都有錨點」的句子挖掉：句首用 This/Such/Another＋前一句名詞的換說法，後一句再重複句中的一個關鍵詞
至少 1 格放主題句或承上啟下句（現制 5/5 篇），但線索要在相鄰句
多餘句寫成與主題相關的一般陳述，句首不用指涉詞與連接詞，放進任何一格都缺先行詞或接不上後一句
pitfalls: 只靠轉折詞當線索：連接詞格（CN）合併 P 中位數 0.505，比詞彙鏈格（LX）的 0.66 難，超越頂標占 17% 對 3%
兩個選項指向同一個先行詞（例：111-32 與 111-33 都可接 mukaebi 的 bonfire），會把題目推到超越頂標
多餘句含有可解的代名詞或 also、another，意外接得上某一格

verification.human_review: 100%（校準期：每個題型 × 提示詞版本的前 30 組全審，SPEC §5.8）
